name: DC2 official sources, third batch (China)
policy: Every name appears verbatim in its captured document; capacities go through the versioned extractor. USGS 2024 facilities table, unit t (metric tons, checked), no year in the table title: period = calendar 2024, as for the Gulf batch. Only rows that name one site are recorded; rows for several provinces or several bases are left out. No company or owner link in this batch: no company's jurisdiction is stated in the source. A row is left out when anything in it is uncertain (ditto facility names, a doubtful spelling, an aggregate). Labels use only what the row itself writes, never a ditto company name. USGS capacities were cross-checked against the listed operators' 2024 annual reports; where the operator's report contradicts or casts doubt on the USGS figure, the plant is kept and its capacity left out.
to_confirm: Every China capacity is a USGS estimate (e); kept as with the Gulf and Australia batches

Unit checked: the Facilities table has a Unit column with 't' on every aluminium row, and the chapter defines t as metric tons ('29,209 metric tons (t)'); the values are tonnes, not thousand t (e.g. Weiqiao Zouping metal 6,500,000 t)

Wenshan ownership, sources disagree (recorded, not resolved here): USGS 2024 Facilities table, pages 17-18: 'Yunnan Wenshan Aluminium Co. Ltd. [Aluminum Corporation of China (Chinalco), 100%]'. Chalco (Aluminum Corporation of China Ltd.) 2024 annual report, HKEX 2025041600473: 'the Company owned 29.10% of the total issued share capital of Yunnan Aluminum' and 'controls in aggregate 42.10% voting rights'; no figure for Wenshan itself. Yunnan Aluminium (云铝股份, 000807) 2024 annual report, http://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2025-03-27/1222911954.PDF, subsidiary table: '云铝文山 ... 云南文山 云南文山 制造 100.00%' (Wenshan Aluminium, registered and operating in Wenshan, Yunnan, 100% held by Yunnan Aluminium), and '全资子公司云南文山铝业有限公司'. So the direct holder is Yunnan Aluminium (100%), not Chinalco; no ownership link is recorded in this batch

Company cross-check of the capacities (2024 annual reports on cninfo, the exchanges' official disclosure site). Agree with USGS: Shenhuo Wenshan smelter (Shenhuo (神火股份, 000933) 2024 annual report summary, http://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2025-03-25/1222881394.PDF: '云南神火 90 万吨/年'), Tianshan Shihezi smelter (Tianshan Aluminum (天山铝业, 002532) 2024 annual report, http://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2025-04-18/1223122101.PDF: '已建成 120 万吨电解铝产能'), Wenshan alumina refinery (Yunnan Aluminium (云铝股份, 000807) 2024 annual report, http://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2025-03-27/1222911954.PDF: '云铝文山已形成年产 140 万吨氧化铝生产规模'), Longkou Donghai alumina refinery (Nanshan Aluminium (南山铝业, 600219) 2024 annual report, http://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2025-03-25/1222881062.PDF: alumina '国内在产产能 140 万吨'). Disagree or doubtful: Jingxi Tiangui refinery, Nanshan Longkou smelter, Jiaozuo Wanfang smelter, Henan Zhongfu Gongyi and Linzhou smelters (capacities left out, see excluded). Also read: Jiuquan Steel (酒钢宏兴, 600307) 2024 annual report, http://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2025-04-30/1223412908.PDF (Gansu Dongxing is a fellow subsidiary, '母公司的全资子公司'; no smelter figure). Searched on cninfo without a listed company: East Hope, Huayin, Bosai, Qingtongxia. Not checked: Jinsheng (Hangzhou Jinjiang), Huayang, Xiangjiang Wanji, Jinxin, Zhongrui, Yugang; their USGS capacities stand uncorroborated

Chinese company reports give capacities in 万吨 (10,000 t); the Core takes t, kt or Mt only, so a 万吨 figure cannot be extracted verbatim. Capacities from these reports (e.g. Shenhuo's Xinjiang smelter, '新疆煤电 80 万吨/年', which USGS does not list) need a Core unit change first; they are not in this batch

Company and owner links for a later batch: needs a source that states each company's jurisdiction, e.g. the subsidiary table of Chalco's annual report ('PRC/Mainland China') or of Yunnan Aluminium's (注册地 per subsidiary)
